shared_elements: low-relief carving with flat raised planes
elaborately curled/beaded hair and beards rendered as regular rows of curls
long fringed or patterned garments on standing figures
figures holding objects in outstretched hands
procession of figures facing in one direction
register organisation with a horizontal border band at top and bottom
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile with stylised rows of tight curls in hair and beard, wearing long garments and carrying/holding objects, set in a horizontal register bounded by decorative bands, with figures facing and advancing in one direction — a conventional, non-universal combination of traits suggesting a shared relief tradition. The main differences in content are that A is a close confrontation of two large facing figures with drinking/pouring vessels and a weapon, while B is a multi-figure procession that includes led rams and a stylised tree, plus rosette borders absent from A.
